source.label: Ternary windows and ordinary moving families

reviewer: Codex with one isolated medium reviewer; final PASS after the characteristic-three degree-scope clarification

claims.summary: For dimension8,d>=6,char3,q=3^e>=N=128d-320, the moving coefficient's column-support condition is q<=N+63; outside it the coefficient vanishes. Supported pairs have e mod32 in{4,5,6,9,11,12,13,14,15,16,17,18,19,23,24,26}, delta=(3^e mod128)-64 and d=(q+320-delta)/128, with classes4,5 starting at e36,37. All nine c mod9 fourth-merge profiles are explicit, retaining polynomial prefixes and cut-factor outliers. For adjacent profiles with pole offsets Kplus,Kminus and codimensions kappa=2K-7, the exact sufficient conic matching map has size kappa_plus+max(kappa_minus,gap)<=48, gap=(63-delta)/2; its lower matching numerator power is q-(26+Kplus-Kminus), with free or excess-degree conditions retained. Inside support, determinant nonvanishing is not asserted for every class.
claims.assessment: Working complete finite-period source classification and all-parameter matching construction passed by one isolated medium reviewer. Lucas periodicity and the two nonzero high-row entries prove the nine profiles uniformly from the complete rightmost-pivot table. Polynomial division and character independence retain every source direction. Full counting and Taylor matching prove the square sizes, including free versus excess lower degrees; all16 arithmetic states and maximum48 are checked.
claims.rationale: Supplies the complete source and support inventory needed to extend original moving-coefficient proofs without a growing degree survey. It generalizes the preceding26-condition reduction; no independent novelty claim.
claims.next_action: Prove the still-unresolved matching determinants, beginning the upper1/lower2 profile pair at exponent classes11 and26.

claims.summary: Over every characteristic-three field, original generic V_(8,d) is normal on two infinite families: e=32t+36, q=3^e,d=(q+303)/128,N=q-17; and e=32t+9,d=(q+285)/128,N=q-35, t>=0. The actual moving coefficient at a8^(s alpha) is nonzero, and the characteristic-three reduction of the original integral determinant has exact last-parameter degree (q-delta-64)(q+1)/4, delta17 or35. Both adjacent conic profiles are ordinary. Their residual26/17 matrices have leading terms2u256/u166, certified by exact polynomial right-inverse congruences and global-power bounds. Together with the earlier class6 family, three of sixteen supported exponent classes are proved; other classes and pre-stable thresholds remain open.
claims.assessment: Working uniform nonvanishing theorem passed by one isolated medium reviewer, with exact degree explicitly restricted to the characteristic-three reduction. Bounded Taylor formulas give uniform entries modulo u192; exact polynomial inverse certificates with poles24/21 protect leading orders256/166 against errors424/337. Positive global-tag terms have order at least L-1148/L-437, beyond the leading terms throughout both valid families. An independent direct Taylor control verifies the19-to17 normalization at the first actual class9 member without constructing its large original jet matrix.
claims.rationale: Adds two new unbounded original normality families at characteristic three, with an exact source-preserving coefficient proof rather than finite-rank extrapolation.
claims.next_action: Treat the exceptional-upper/ordinary-lower profile pair in the remaining support window, retaining its actual outliers.
